data.rationale: Spawned a fresh agent with NO prior context to test the --continuity protocol. Result: Successfully recovered cognitive state in ~5 minutes. Agent correctly identified: Seven Pillars, breakthrough decision, identity, and next work. Issues found: 'decision why' was documented incorrectly (should be 'decision show'). Fixed the documentation. The protocol works - a fresh agent can bootstrap identity without reading CLAUDE.md.
data.title: Sub-agent validated cognitive continuity protocol
